name: Crime
overview: Scripture reveals that crime is fundamentally a violation of God's moral order, with serious consequences for both individuals and society. From the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) to the principle of just restitution for theft and harm (Exodus 21:24; 22:1), God's law demands accountability and justice. The Lord requires the life of man for murder (Genesis 9:5), emphasizing the sacredness of human life, while also affirming that each person bears responsibility for their own sin (Ezekiel 18:20). The wicked who love violence are detested by God (Psalms 11:5), underscoring His righteous judgment against crime and wrongdoing.
